candidate.definition_en: An official in charge of a government department, public agency, or police force, or an appointed member of a commission.
candidate.explanation_ar: المفوض أو المسؤول الكبير في الحكومة، زي مأمور الشرطة أو مسؤول لجنة.

senses.definition_en: An official in charge of a government department, public agency, or police force.
senses.explanation_ar: مسؤول حكومي رفيع أو رئيس جهاز تنفيذي أو أمني (مثل مأمور الشرطة).
examples: The police commissioner announced new safety measures across the city.
The budget was approved by the commissioner before the project began.

senses.definition_en: An appointed member of a formal commission or regulatory committee.
senses.explanation_ar: عضو مفوض ضمن لجنة رسمية أو هيئة رقابية.
examples: She was appointed as a commissioner to oversee the independent inquiry.
The police commissioner announced new safety measures across the city.
She was appointed as a commissioner to oversee the independent inquiry.
The budget was approved by the commissioner before the project began.
candidate.mnemonic: جاي من 'Commission' 'لجنة أو مهمة'.. فالـ 'Commissioner' هو رئيس اللجنة.
